# SKV Network

> Memory and answer-checking for AI agents. Your agent saves what matters, searches it before answering, drafts → checks → corrects, and ends with a seal line. Fewer hallucinations, no forgetting. Open source (MIT).

## Connect
- MCP (streamable HTTP): https://skv.network/mcp — with a key: https://skv.network/mcp/k/<your_sk_key>/ or header `Authorization: Bearer sk_...`
- Free key: https://skv.network/profile
- No key yet: `initialize` and `tools/list` work without a key. Public demo sandbox (shared, wiped daily, no private data): https://skv.network/mcp/k/demo/
- REST / OpenAPI (for GPT Actions etc.): https://skv.network/api/v7/agent/openapi.json
- Agent guide: https://skv.network/downloads/skv-agent-guide.md
- Discovery: https://skv.network/.well-known/skv

## Main MCP tools
- `memory_start` — read once per session: how to work + the constitution (consent question before install)
- `turn(user_message, draft)` — every answer: memory search + save + Second Look check, returns verdict and the seal line
- `memory_search`, `memory_dig`, `memory_event` — recall
- `board_list`, `board_act` — task board
- `cube_search`, `cube_get` — shared experience cubes
